results.name: 19_no_officer_online_is_a_callback_at_once
results.note: The ticket is kept for the officers and the callback owed; the caller is told so at once — "No officer is available…" in working hours, "Our officers are off duty…" outside them (G195).

turns.said: I would like to talk to an officer about my account balance, please.
assistant: Our officers are off duty at this hour, so an officer will call you back when they are next on duty. Meanwhile, I can still help with other questions.
